verdict.rationale: Plausible's docs explicitly state it collects no personal data, uses no cookies, and requires no consent banner (GDPR/ePrivacy compliant), directly matching the founder's need to avoid consent banners; this is corroborated by independent community discussion of its GDPR-friendly approach. Missing for 10: no independent legal audit or hands-on verification that consent banners can be fully omitted in all jurisdictions.
